subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do we approve upgrading `openai/codex-action` and `actions/create-github-app-token` in workflows that receive OpenAI API keys or GitHub App private keys as part of this grouped Dependabot update?
rationale: The diff changes trusted third-party executable code at secret-bearing workflow boundaries; source inspection can identify the boundary but cannot substitute for the repository owner's acceptance of the supply-chain and workflow-privilege change.

options.title: Review and approve the privileged revisions
options.body: Inspect the upstream release changes and approve only after the final merge head has successful trusted workflow evidence.

options.title: Split or defer privileged action updates
options.body: Land only independently reviewed non-privileged action updates and keep the secret-bearing revisions for a narrower owner-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Review and approve the privileged revisions
recommendation.body: Inspect the upstream release changes and approve only after the final merge head has successful trusted workflow evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline supplies a direct current routing signal, while no stronger scoped owner history was available.
